name: A Bengali Legal Corpus and Evaluation Dataset for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in Legal Question Answering
description: This dataset presents a Bengali legal corpus and an evaluation dataset designed to support research on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for legal question answering. The legal corpus is derived from the Bangladesh Road Transport Act, 2018, and contains structured legal provisions enriched with metadata, including section and subsection information, keywords, legal topics, and relationships between related sections. The evaluation dataset consists of 514 Bengali legal scenarios categorized into Natural Language, Legal Language, Factual, and Out of Context types. Each scenario is annotated with corresponding gold legal references to support the evaluation of legal information retrieval and question-answering systems. The dataset is intended to facilitate research on Bengali legal NLP, evidence-based legal retrieval, RAG pipelines, and the development and evaluation of legal question-answering systems in the Bangladeshi legal context.
